# Stormline Editor | Premium Glass Desktop UI Visual System v0.1

**DESIGN PROPOSAL ONLY, not UI implemented, no image/SVG/logo/icon file generated by this Work Order.** Owner requested refined modern glassmorphism, polished icons and operating-system-grade application design. Use as an inspiration for quality, **not an imitation of any specific Apple visual asset, icon, dock, OS screenshot, SF Symbols asset or trade dress**. Baseline `356695b078001f4f9caa94d1119ae045bf391375`; [Brand Foundation](../brand/brand-foundation.md) is PROPOSED with Stormline-specific graphite, blue and cyan. Future design/art final selection requires visual concepts and owner approval.

## Creative principles
1. **Precision, silence and depth.** Treat the scene viewport as the hero, tools as controlled instrument panels, and glass as a subtle depth cue, never a fog filter across content.
2. **Real utility**: menus, scene hierarchy, inspector, tabs, asset browser and timeline remain legible under bright HDR/gameplay viewports. State distinctions must survive monochrome, blur-off and color blindness.
3. **Original identity**: Stormline's energy-line/S mark is a potential proposal, not an existing approved logo. Use optical grid alignment and purpose-designed icons.
4. **Fluid but disciplined**: 120–200ms hover/selection, 180–260ms pane transitions illustrative only, obey reduced-motion and input latency; no obligatory animated splash or layout shifts.
5. **App-quality polish**: consistent spacing, radii, state feedback, typography, welcome/onboarding and empty states; no unnecessary sci-fi HUD chrome or neon overuse.

## Desktop information architecture
### A. Launcher / Project Hub
Recent projects with thumbnail, owner and path, last-opened date and target; primary New/Open with keyboard navigation; tutorials/samples only rights-cleared originals; recovery from interrupted project load. Friendly glass cards, lightweight gradients, no account required by default.

### B. Main Editor (reference wireframe, not a pixel-perfect Apple replica)
```text
+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| STORMLINE | project | command search | build target | status |
+----+--------------+--------------------------+--------------+
|rail| Scene Tree   | Scene Viewport / 2D-3D  | Inspector    |
|    | Hierarchy    | grid / gizmos / overlays | properties   |
|    | Assets       |                          | history      |
|    |              |                          |              |
+----+--------------+--------------------------+--------------+
| Asset Browser / Console / Profiler / Graph / Timeline (dock)  |
+--------------------------------------------------------------+
```
This is only a **functional zone plan**. Exact panel dimensions are proposals subject to testing (e.g., rail 56–72px, hierarchy min 220px, inspector min 280px, viewport must retain useful space at 1280px). Support docking/tabbing, splitter keyboard controls, saved layouts, multiple displays, zoom, DPI scale and localized long labels; prioritize central viewport. Full-screen preview and distraction-free focus mode need explicit escape path.

### C. Materials / Shader / VFX Graph
Large graph canvas, structured ports, node search, preview panes, invalid links indicated beyond color, background compilation status, safe cancel, undo/redo. Graph data transactions belong to engine owner contracts, not UI paint state.

### D. 2D/UI/Timeline Tools
Pixel-perfect grid/snap options, fonts with Unicode shaping, atlas preview and tile painting, timeline lanes/audio cues, playhead keyboard traversal and stable frame labels. Transparent cards behind gameplay content require local opaque contrast layer when busy.

### E. AI/Automation command surface
Readable pending actions, exact target entities/permissions, dry-run diff, owner confirmation, revert/rollback outcome and command receipt. AI suggestions never write project files directly and never impersonate approved system permissions.

### F. Release / Diagnostics
Build target capability matrix showing Windows/Linux/macOS/Web qualification honestly; progress + error receipts, signatures and distribution rights only if actually approved. Distinguish conceptual future workflows from a working installer.

## Original icon family spec
- Initial semantic families: Files/Projects, World, Scene/Hierarchy, Entity, Asset, Mesh, Material, Light, Camera, Sprite, Tilemap, Animation, VFX, Audio, Script, Graph, Node, Play/Pause/Stop, Profiler, Console, Build, Publish, AI Review, Shield, Undo/Redo, Save, Search, Settings and Help.
- One grid, coherent optical x-height, limited corner radii, positive/negative states, meaningful labels/tooltips. Plan monochrome baseline plus optional restrained blue active state. Source SVG originals with metadata/usage license after separate art WO and owner visual approval; never embed copyrighted third-party glyphs by default.
- Contrast and affordance: minimum intended text 4.5:1 and nontext control boundaries 3:1 where WCAG applies; these are **future validation targets**, not currently measured passes. Test visual weight at 16, 20, 24 and 32 px plus 200% UI scale.

## Components inventory, style targets
- Buttons: primary, quiet, danger and disabled; clear busy/error state, keyboard focus.
- Glass panel and dropdown: background blur limited to decoration; opaque fallback preserves text contrast; viewport must not dim unpredictably.
- Inspector property rows: aligned labels/unit inputs, keyboard direct editing, constrained numeric formats, validation messages, undo.
- Search/command palette: fuzzy matches, keyboard order, shortcut hints, result provenance and safe command preview.
- Tabs, menus, tooltips, dialogs and sheets: focus trap, escape, asynchronous feedback and proper screen-reader role.
- Tree/node/list/grid data: virtualization later only if data/perf evidence justifies; no silent hidden selection state.
- Timeline/panels: adjustable row density and graph interactions without animation on every input frame.

## Design QA, benchmark and asset approval (future)
| Check | Required future evidence | Failure example |
|---|---|---|
| Figma/visual reference fidelity | approved screenshot/ref ID, exact viewport density, theme, DPI and version | unintended overflow, fonts/asset discrepancy |
| A11y focus/keyboard | keyboard-only walkthrough, focus visible, screen reader labels, high contrast | hidden active focus in translucent bar |
| Reduced transparency | blur=0 screenshot, GPU device-loss and remote desktop fallback | white-on-busy viewport becomes unreadable |
| Performance | frame-time p50/p95/p99 with/without glass effect on low-tier iGPU and representative scene | backdrop blur consumes user viewport budget |
| Layout | 1280×720, 1440p, 4K, high DPI, narrow Web, multi-monitor, localization stress | inspector unusable / viewport squeezed |
| Icon exports | SVG source original/rights, 16px monochrome/dark/light/active and optical review | fuzzy stroke, cloned Apple/System glyph |
| Motion | reduced-motion, low FPS, interrupted transitions and input responsiveness | blocking animation on destructive confirmation |
| Asset/source license | SPDX/license notices, source IDs and original briefs | proprietary font or unlicensed image in bundle |
| Error/recovery UX | offline/open-failed/project-conflict/corrupt asset screens with keyboard exit | spinner without error/undo |
| Owner approval | explicit final direction/asset acceptance with sha and checkpoint | proposal self-marked as final UI |

The approved future editor toolkit, font choice, icon assets, final design tokens and all actual UI artifacts remain **UNDECIDED/NOT PRODUCED**.
